//: offline-bundle manifest. One per skill. Fill in, then: python pack.py add <skill-dir> --manifest <this-file>

skill_source.//: type=local copies a local dir; type=git clones a repo

target.//: Target intranet environment. pack.py cross-downloads for this.

tools.name: manual-exe
tools.note: Download X msi manually, place in bundle/tools/manual/, install on intranet
